name: WPF Filterable Data Grid Panel
description: Reusable WPF UserControl wrapping DataGrid with live ICollectionView text filtering, status pills, keyboard focus handling, and MVVM ViewModel.

preview.caption: Native Windows WPF control — does not execute in a browser. Inspect XAML + C# source tabs or drop into a .NET WPF project.
architecture: Virtualized DataGrid with 4 Bound Columns (Name, Category, Status, Version)
preview.projectRef: Drop into any <UseWPF>true</UseWPF> .NET Desktop project under Controls/FilterableDataGrid/

install: Copy FilterableDataGrid.xaml, FilterableDataGrid.xaml.cs, and DataGridViewModel.cs into your WPF project (ensure <UseWPF>true</UseWPF> in your .csproj).
usage: Set DataContext to new DataGridViewModel(items) and place <controls:FilterableDataGrid /> inside your Window or Page layout.

verification.label: WPF Compile & ViewModel Checked
verification.details: DataGridViewModel compiled and unit-tested with .NET; XAML structure validated cross-platform and compiled natively with <UseWPF>true</UseWPF> in Windows CI. Interactive desktop rendering requires a Windows WPF host.
